{{Top}}
The infamous '''Klatooinian Trade Guild''' was formed almost five thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the fall of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Its original purpose was to provide [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinians]] a chance to work on [[Planet/Legends|planets]] far from [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]]. However, this meant they were sold into indentured servitude to the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] and the Guild became but a front for several shady Hutt endeavors, including [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]], loan-sharking, and [[Slavery/Legends|slaving]].<ref name="LoNH">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref>

The Guild had many enclaves within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Many [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and [[free-trader]]s joined the guild after hearing they provided [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] in return for some years of service as [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]]. In truth, the Guild practically enslaved their employees, controlling them and their transports and chaining them with debt and blackmail.{{Company-stub}}
